statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, (Finset.range X).sum (fun n => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n*ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+1)) ≤ C * Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 零点对与相位 · TP-0024 · 控制差一相关总量的平方对数上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Zero pairs and phases · TP-0024 · Bound the entire gap-one correlation by a squared logarithm

brief.zh: 每个二的幂可作两个相邻对的偶数端，每项只花 log 2 与一次 log X。
brief.en: Each power of two can occur at either end and costs log 2 times a single log X.
